# Uploading logo in Design -> Theme & Logo in multistore with a single shop selected causes TypeError with PHP 8.3

Updating a logo, mail logo or invoice in multistore with single shop selected causes TypeError with PHP 8.3 and crashes. 

**TypeError**
_ShopCore::getGroupIdFromShopId(): Argument #1 ($shopId) must be of type int, null given, called in ../prestashop/classes/shop/Shop.php on line 1015_

This issue also causes **ShopException** _Shop group id 0 is invalid. Shop group id must be a number that is greater than zero._



Culprit is `\PrestaShop\PrestaShop\Core\Shop\LogoUploader::updateInMultiShopContext`  that calls `Shop::setContext(Shop::CONTEXT_SHOP);` without `$idShop` as second argument even though it is readily available. Without `$idShop` `\ShopCore::setContext` tries to call `Shop::getGroupIdFromShopId($id)` with $id value of null and getGroupIdFromShopId is defined with typehint int.
I searched the project and luckily didn't find any other invalid calls to `Shop::setContext(Shop::CONTEXT_SHOP);` without Shop ID so just adding idShop as argument should be enough.

`\PrestaShop\PrestaShop\Core\Shop\LogoUploader::updateInMultiShopContext` also makes couple of calls `Shop::setContext(Shop::CONTEXT_GROUP);` without second `$id` argument that is also available in the same function. Therefore that is probably not working as intended and might cause some issues, but I didn't get in that deep.

## Attendu
Uploading theme logo would change the logo.

## Étapes
In multistore with a single shop selected
1. Open Design -> Theme & Logo
2. Check Header logo
3. Add logo file 
4. Click Save
